feastLines.line: 🔥 The fire settles. Sofia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Saul says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Robin asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

"It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Yara asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Emma says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ivy asks "The fire feels smaller now." Robin says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
